does: Gives the translated title of an ability check for the roll screen (Strength Check, Dexterity Check ...), one localisation handle per EAbility.

evidence.says: a switch over the EAbility value, each case building a TranslatedString from a fixed localisation handle

A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a dialogue was on (segments 4, 16, 31, 32, the dialogue rolls), 5 times from 1 place, the active-roll title code at +0x1546360
